title: A person who focuses only on what is wrong with something turns dislike into an urge to attack or escape it
body:
- A person first singles out a specific target — a person, situation, or event — and judges it undesirable.
- Attention then narrows onto the target's negative features while filtering out positive or neutral qualities, producing perceptual distortion.
- The narrowed perception culminates in blaming the target and generating an urge to attack it or escape from it.
conversion: Selective attention to negatives converts measured dislike into an impulse to attack or escape, because the positives that would have tempered the reaction have been filtered out.
